user.title: Connect to the Hikvision NVR
user.description: Enter the NVR IP address, HTTP port and credentials. The credentials are stored in Home Assistant and are only sent to the NVR.

channels.title: Choose channels
channels.description: Model: {model}, host: {host}. Select one or more camera channels whose perimeter-protection / region-intrusion upload-center links should be controlled by the same switch. The NVR's channels 7 and 8 are pre-selected when present.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the NVR
reauth_confirm.description: The NVR rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current username and password.

error.invalid_host: The host must not be empty.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password is incorrect.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the NVR. Check the IP address, port, scheme and network.
error.api_error: The NVR rejected the ISAPI request. Check that ISAPI is enabled and the account has sufficient permissions.
error.no_channels: No camera channels were found on the NVR.
error.invalid_channel: Please select at least one valid channel.
error.channel_not_supported: At least one selected channel does not expose the field-detection (region intrusion) event. Choose another channel.
error.invalid_scan_interval: The polling interval must be between 10 and 300 seconds.
error.already_configured: These NVR channels have already been configured.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: These NVR channels have already been configured.
